requests.prompt: Create an environment design reference sheet for a side-scrolling pixel-art action game, not a finished production tileset. The attached native robot sprite strip is ONLY a reference for crisp pixel clusters, restrained materials, and palette; do not draw those robots or any characters. Show exactly THREE equal square panels in one horizontal row with clean spacing, locked flat side-view camera and consistent 16-pixel module scale. Panel 1: an ancient Chinese mechanism study, dark lacquered timber brackets and mortise joints, stone plinths, a bamboo-scroll cabinet, a circular geometric lattice window, and one hanging paper lantern. Panel 2: the same architecture overtaken by a bioluminescent forest, twisting roots, broad quiet leaf masses, mossy soil, and a small stone lantern; include one clearly distinct floating purple poisonous mushroom, not many scattered collectibles. Panel 3: a spacious quiet mechanism arena using the same stone and timber vocabulary, restrained circular lattice architecture behind an open combat area, with two thin suspended wooden ledges. Keep empty readable space around the ledges. In every panel the walkable top edges are straight unbroken horizontal pixel rows; grass and roots stay below those edges, and the ledges read as only 12 pixels thick inside a 16-pixel module. Do not add walkable-looking decorative bridges across gaps. Use low contrast and sparse clustered texture on the back wall, stronger but not glaring contrast on the foreground top edge. A surface should be mostly one calm midtone, with only three or four material colors; no noisy speckles, soft gradients, photographic texture, isometric perspective, bloom, or blur. Upper-left light, hard pixel edges, restrained selective outlines. Color family only: #0f191b #24423b #426b50 #8fa86b #2c2330 #34354f #575c79 #858eb0 #783f4a #b55a4a #eaa083 #b9905d #e5c386 #cbb696 #f5e8c8 #9dded1 #d9ffea #723f68. Reserve exact #d97757 for the absent player and do not use it here. No UI, writing, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, characters, attacks, targeting marks, health bars, or decorative fake projectiles. This is a compact cohesive environment concept, not a website or a moodboard collage.
